Mathematics BSc (Hons) at University of Edinburgh

What University of Edinburgh asks of applicants to Mathematics BSc (Hons) for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Edinburgh courses · Mathematics field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 4 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma:
    • three standardised test scores in different subjects are expected
    • SAT 1290+ (650+ Reading and Writing, 620+ Math) or ACT 27+ can count as one of them, alongside at least two AP scores at 4+ including required subjects
  • SAT/ACT is not required when three AP scores at 4+ (including required subjects) are offered
  • Applicants whose school offers no AP tests:
    • GPA 3.3+ and, in most circumstances, ACT 27+ or SAT 1290 (650+ Reading and Writing, 620 Maths)
    • College of Science and Engineering selection tests may also be offered

Edinburgh does not superscore the ACT; it will consider a superscore for the SAT.

Verified19 Oct 2026Edinburgh: Undergraduate entry requirements — United States of America · Edinburgh College of Science and Engineering: Applying with USA qualifications
English language
  • IELTS Academic: 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each component (IELTS One Skill Retake not accepted)
  • TOEFL iBT:
    • 92 overall with at least 20 in each component (tests before 21 January 2026)
    • 4.5 overall with at least 4.0 in each component (tests from 21 January 2026)
    • TOEFL MyBest not accepted
  • C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency:
    • 176 overall with at least 162 in each component
    • Oxford ELLT: 7 overall with at least 5 in each component
    • Oxford Test of English Advanced: 145 overall with at least 125 in each component
  • IELTS, TOEFL iBT and Oxford tests must be no more than two years old at the programme start date
  • US nationals (a majority English-speaking country) can instead use, for example, Grade 11 English at C, ACT 25 in both English and Reading, or SAT 650 in Reading and Writing

Trinity ISE is listed for 2026 entry only; Edinburgh says it is reviewing Trinity ISE for 2027 entry.

None listed on the official source

Subject prerequisites
  • Required: Mathematics — A level Mathematics at A*, or IB HL Mathematics (Analysis and approaches only) at 7, achieved no more than two academic years before entry
  • Preferred: Further Mathematics

Mathematics at A* required; Further Mathematics preferred. The IB HL Mathematics 7 and two-year recency details are quoted in the A level/IB rows, not in this row's snippet.

Edinburgh publishes a standard range from 38 points with 766 at HL to 34 points with 765 at HL (2027 entry); no IB points score is shown because the matching engine stores none for this course. Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement:
    • 3 AP exams
    • Not counted: AP Research
  • School of Mathematics:
    • AP Calculus at 5 is required
    • AP Calculus BC in addition to AP Calculus AB may be preferred
  • AP Seminar, AP Research and AP Studio Art are not accepted for entry to College of Science and Engineering programmes
  • AP scores are used for admissions only; no advanced credit is awarded
